 SSC EXAM DATES NOVEMBER 2026 OUT 
 SSC Exam Dates November 2026 Out: Check CGEPT, Departmental and Delhi Police SI Schedule
 Staff Selection Commission has announced the examination timetable through notice F.No. HQ-EC033/7/2025-EC issued on 02.11.2026. The SSC Exam Dates November 2026 notice provides official dates for multiple computer-based examinations and skill tests scheduled across November 2026. Candidates are advised to visit the official website regularly for subsequent updates. Roshni Yadav 3 Nov, 2026 Share

 Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially issued the exam schedule for various recruitment tests scheduled in November 2026. The commission published the formal schedule via Important Notice reference number F.No. HQ-EC033/7/2025-EC on 02.11.2026. Candidates preparing for these examinations can now review the confirmed test dates for their respective tiers and modes.
 The official schedule outlines the timetable for the Coast Guard Enrolled Persons Test (CGEPT), the Annual Departmental Typing and Stenographer Skill Test, and the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination (Paper-II). Candidates must check the mode and date carefully to plan their test day requirements accordingly.
 Candidates preparing for other Staff Selection Commission examinations can also refer to the SSC examination updates and schedules for information about upcoming recruitment tests.
 SSC Exam Schedule November 2026
 The Staff Selection Commission has scheduled these examinations across different dates in November 2026. The tests include Computer Based Examinations (CBE) as well as skill-based tests. Candidates can check the detailed official timetable in the table below:

 Candidates can also check the SSC Calendar 2026 to review the broader examination timeline and other important dates announced by the commission.
 SSC Coast Guard Enrolled Persons Test (CGEPT) 2026
 The Staff Selection Commission has scheduled the Coast Guard Enrolled Persons Test (CGEPT) for Batch 01/2027 and Batch 02/2027 on November 17 and 18, 2026. The examination will be conducted in Computer-Based Examination (CBE) mode.
 Candidates appearing for the test should check the official SSC website for updates regarding their examination city, shift timings and other instructions.
 SSC Annual Departmental Typing and Stenographer Skill Test 2026
 The Annual Departmental Typing Test (English/Hindi) and Stenographer Skill Test (English/Hindi) Examination, 2025, will be conducted on November 20 and 21, 2026.
 The examination will be held in skill-test mode. Candidates should check the official instructions for details about the typing and stenography tests.
 Delhi Police and CAPFs SI Paper 2 Exam Date 2026
 The Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination 2025 (Paper-II) will be conducted on November 28, 2026 , in Computer-Based Examination (CBE) mode.
 Candidates who qualified in the Physical Endurance Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) should prepare for the next examination stage. They can check the SSC CPO PET/PST Result 2026 update for details about the qualified candidates and Paper-II examination.
 For further examination-related information, candidates can also refer to the SSC CPO Exam Date 2026 page. Those tracking the separate 2026 recruitment cycle can check the revised SSC CPO examination schedule .
 Official Notice Details
 The commission released the timetable on 02.11.2026 under Document Reference Number F.No. HQ-EC033/7/2025-EC. The notification confirms that CGEPT will be held on 17th and 18th November 2026 via CBE mode. The Annual Departmental Typing and Stenographer Skill Test takes place on 20th and 21st November 2026. Delhi Police and CAPFs Sub-Inspector Paper-II is set for 28th November 2026.
 Candidate Guidelines and Updates
 Candidates should follow these instructions while preparing for the November 2026 examinations:
 Check the examination date and mode applicable to your respective test.
 Visit the official SSC website regularly for updates regarding examination city, shift timings and other instructions.
 Read the relevant examination guidelines before appearing for the test.
 Keep checking the official portal for admission certificate and examination-related announcements.
 For other SSC recruitment updates, refer to the SSC exam updates page .
 Candidates should rely on the official commission notices for the latest and final examination instructions.
